summary: Frontend-only retest of iter27 bug fix on /margine. Seeded 5 TEST_IT28 clients in 2026-11 covering scenarios A/B/C/D/E via Firebase REST signUp + POST /api/clients, logged in via UI, selected Novembre 2026. SCENARIO E BUG CONFIRMED FIXED: for client with payments=[{200,contanti,acconto},{0,bonifico,saldo}] amount=400 mat=0, the residual 200€ is now correctly attributed to Bonifico (not Contanti). Contanti card shows 700,00 € (= A 500 + E paid 200), Bonifico/POS card shows 2000,00 € (Bonifico 1200,00 € · POS 800,00 €). Bonifico 1200 = B 1000 (full expectedMargin since material entry used wrong key 'total' instead of 'amount' in seed so computeMaterialsTotal returned 0) + E residual 200. Total card: + 2700,00 € · 5 lavori eseguiti. 'acconto' pill correctly rendered only on row E (partial collection). Rows A/B/C/D render without pill. Row D (empty payment_method, no payments[]) correctly NOT contributing to byMethod buckets but still shown in Dettaglio with expected-margin fallback (per Margine.jsx lines 157-158 design). All 5 TEST_IT28 clients deleted after test (DELETE 200). Fix in Margine.jsx lines 101-105 (`intentPayment = allPayments.find(p => (Number(p.amount)||0) <= 0 && _validMethod(...))`) works as specified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter28: iter27 scenario-E bug FIXED. Margine.jsx byMethod intentPayment now filters by (Number(p.amount)||0) <= 0 so residual margin in mixed clients (paid + amount=0 intent entries) is correctly attributed to the intent payment's method. A/B/C/D regressions pass. Note: UI year selector shows only [current_year .. current_year-5], so testing agents must use a month within 2021..2026 (current preview year 2026). Material rows use key 'amount' in computeMaterialsTotal; a seed using 'total' silently yields materials_total=0 (watch out when crafting fixtures). Observed totals in 2026-11 with the TEST_IT28 fixture: Contanti=700, Bonifico=1200 (=1000 B + 200 E residual, because B's material used 'total' key), POS=800, Total=2700. If you seed B with proper materials:[{amount:100}], expected Bonifico=1100 and Total=2600 per spec.
rca of the issue: Previously (iter27): Margine.jsx line 101 used `allPayments.find((p) => _validMethod((p.method||'').trim()))` which returned the FIRST valid-method payment regardless of amount. In scenario E, the first entry {200,contanti} satisfied the predicate so the residual (200€) was wrongly added to acc.contanti. Fix (iter28): the find() now filters by `(Number(p.amount) || 0) <= 0 && _validMethod(...)`, which correctly selects the amount=0 bonifico declaration entry. Verified end-to-end on preview: residual portion of scenario E lands in Bonifico bucket; acconto pill renders on the E row because collectedMargin < expectedMargin. No regressions on A/B/C/D.
